author: Steve Watts
description:
Hearthstone's next expansion is Reign of the Black Empire, a journey back thousands of years into the distant past when the Old Gods were at war with the Titans. GameSpot has an exclusive reveal for a package of Death Knight class cards, including a big legendary that could swing the game in your favor--or even just win it outright.

The three cards are blood runes, which emphasizes control and life-leeching effects. The first is Grafted Knight, a 2-blood rune, 2-mana 3/3 minion with Lifesteal. That's a solid early-game minion with good stats for the cost that should help you stay alive against aggressive decks in the early game.
title: Hearthstone “Reign Of The Black Empire” Card Reveal – G’huun And Death Knight Control

author: Chris Compendio
description:
Hype emanating from the reveal of Metroid Ravenous has translated into an onslaught of memes after a logo generator circulated online. If you're on Reddit or Bluesky, you may have seen the instantly iconic image of Samus Aran aggressively pinning down a mysterious enemy for consumption, but now accompanied by stupid text like "I ASKED FOR NO PICKLES" in the Metroid Ravenous font.

title: Metroid Ravenous Logo Memes Make Phrases Like “Girl Dinner” And “They Took My Ass” Look So Metal

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Resident Evil director Zach Cregger has revealed he was going through hell while making the movie, which is about a man going through hell.

He told The Hollywood Reporter that he had pneumonia for the first half of filming on Resident Evil. For the second half of production, he had Campylobacter jejuni. This causes diarrhea, and man, that sucks for anyone, but especially if you're trying to film a big-budget, highly anticipated film based on a property with legions of fans and great expectations crea
title: Resident Evil Director Was In Horrible Pain Making The Movie

author: Steve Watts
description:
I love Nintendo. It was a formative part of my video game history, and to this day I think it makes some of the most consistently great games in the industry. But you know what I love more? Deals. For proof just look at my Steam backlog, which is full of games I stupidly bought on the basis of their being cheap. Do I have time to play this? No, but it was so cheap! 

This is somewhat of a contradiction in my gaming tastes. Nintendo isn't known for offering sales. In fact, it's notoriously stingy with discounts, offering them rarely, and with only modest savings. So I was cautiously optimistic about the Customer Appreciation Sale, which Nintendo promoted as a larger scale sale than usual. The sale is now ongoing and, well, I should have trusted my instincts. These deals are not good. The sale prices are relegated primarily to older games, and while 30% is a larger discount than usual for Nintendo games on t
title: Nintendo’s Customer Appreciation Sale Flubbed The Goodwill Gesture Attempt

description:
The Resident Evil movie from Weapons and Barbarian director Zach Cregger releases in theaters on September 18. Reviews from critics went live today, and the movie is earning high scores. GameSpot's Resident Evil review scored it an 8 and said it successfully captures the breathless terror of the games.

In fact, it's now the highest-rated video game movie ever. It boasts a mightily impressive 96% on Rotten Tomatoes from 71 reviews and an equally impressive
title: Resident Evil Is Now The Highest-Rated Gaming Movie Ever

author: Cameron Koch
description:
Going into BlizzCon 2026, World of Warcraft Classic fans, myself included, were hoping for what the community coined as Classic+. Instead, what we got is essentially WoW 2, an alternate vision for what Blizzard's legendary MMORPG called World Of Warcraft: Forever.

It wasn't long after Blizzard re-released WoW Classic, the original version of its genre-defining MMO, in 2019 that players started to dream about what might come next. A community that was at one time dominated by calls for Blizzard to make "no changes" to WoW Classic and keep the game as it was two decades ago gave way to an entirely different desire: more. 

Sure, it was fantastic and nostalgic to return to the original version of Azeroth and old-school WoW's slower and more methodical gameplay, bu
title: WoW: Forever Is More Than Classic+, It’s WoW 2

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description: Lego Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight was a fun tribute to the Caped Crusader when it launched earlier this year, but if you're tired of saving Gotham, you can embrace chaos with two of the city's greatest villains: Harley Quinn and the Joker. The duo are headlining the game's Mayhem Collection expansion, and just like Batman, they're dressing in style with multiple outfits that you can unlock during their caper. GameSpot can exclusively reveal one of them: a classic costume for Harley Quinn, pulled directly from 2009's Batman: Arkham Asylum.
title: Lego Batman: Legacy Of The Dark Knight Gives Harley Quinn An Arkham Asylum Makeover

author: Evan Campbell
description:
Here we go again: A new Fire Emblem game is garnering glowing reviews, and I'm thinking this could be the one that finally clicks with me. Launching tomorrow on Switch 2, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave sits at a fantastic 89 metascore (at the time of publication) on GameSpot's sister site Metacritic. That's good enough to place it No. 13 currently on Metacritic's list for best games of 2026. 

In addition, GameSpot's Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave review says this is "the new high point to beat for future entries." As someone who didn't plan to buy the strategy RPG, I'm now second-guessing myself. I have a his
title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave’s Fantastic Reviews Have Me Feeling FOMO

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
Veteran Call of Duty developer Treyarch is finishing up its work on Black Ops 7 and shifting to its next project, but what will that be? That remains to be seen, but Treyarch design director Kevin Drew said in a new Dev Talk video that it might not be what you expect.

Drew said Treyarch has "learned a lot" working on 2024's Black Ops 6 and 2025's Black Ops 7 and "tried a lot of things in our current era."

"But we're ready to make something new and something that nobody's ever experienced before," he said.

That sounds hyperbolic and extreme, and Call of Duty studios are definitely known for grandiose claims.

title: Call Of Duty: Black Ops Dev Teases “Something That Nobody’s Ever Experienced Before”

author: Eric Frederiksen
description:
Few movies can truly say they hit the ground running, but Zach Cregger’s Resident Evil is among them. And that’s a good thing, because after so many Resident Evil movies, every new one needs a running start to have a chance of making it.

We can’t talk about a Resident Evil movie without doing a little bit of table-setting first, though. Resident Evil debuted on PlayStation in 1996 and coined the name for an emerging game genre: Survival Horror. Since then, Paul W.S. Anderson has directed six live-action Resident Evil movies starring his photogenic and acrobatic wife Milla Jovovich. 2021 brought us the Robbie Amell-led Resident Evil: Welcome to Raccoon City. That’s not counting the half-dozen CGI Resident Evil movies that more or less act as canonical extensions of the game series. Generally speaking, the Resident Evil movies have been on a downward trend since early into Anderson’s tenure. Now, in 2026, the unkillable
title: Resident Evil Finally Captures The Breathless Terror Of The Games

author: Eddie Makuch
description:
The Fable reboot in development at Playground Games has been in the works for a long, long time, and part of what's "protected" the game during the lengthy development cycle was that the franchise is so closely associated with Xbox. That's according to Fable game director Ralph Fulton, who told The Guardian, "I genuinely think Fable is an important game."

"What has protected us over a long development cycle is that so many people within Xbox view Fable as vital to the DNA of the platform,” Fulton said. “I would go a step further and say it’s important to video games as a whole. It offers a c
title: Fable Being “Vital To The DNA” Of Xbox Helped Shield The Game From Hardship, Director Says

description:
It never rains, but it does pour for Bloodborne fans holding out hope for some news on From Software's beloved game. Fortunately, you can take some shelter from that storm of disappointment with an official Bloodborne umbrella, and a few items for anyone wanting some souls-like couture in their wardrobe.

The "Childhood's Beginning" umbrella features illustrations of the Caryll Runes on the exterior and a silhouette of the Moon Presence floating in front of the red moon over a field of white flowers on the interior. Even though it's the most pointless piece of clothing ever designed, if you really need a

description:
At BlizzCon, Blizzard announced a partnership with Netflix for an animated Diablo TV show. The announcement caught some by surprise, but Blizzard president Johanna Faries said in an interview that it makes sense for the studio because many people simply don't have the time to invest meaningfully in Blizzard's games, but still might watch a Diablo TV show.

“We have so much fandom around Blizzard that doesn’t always necessarily translate into hardcore gaming time,” she told
title: Blizzard Boss On Why Diablo Is Becoming A TV Show And How Involved The Studio Will Be

After a successful rebrand earlier this year, the mood around Overwatch has been far more positive recently. Speaking to GameSpot at BlizzCon, associate game director Alec Dawson attributed the recent success to ditching the fear of changing core systems--such as the introduction of a Perk system that fundamentally alters hero capabilities--embarking on a year-long narrative, and actively working to break player expectations.

"Being able to continue to surprise people is really important,"

author: Steve Watts
description:
Even for a series known for its sprawling scope, Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave is ambitious. Nintendo and developer Intelligent Systems clearly approached this latest entry in the series having learned from its success in Three Houses, its missteps in Engage, and even some of the series' historical oddities. Fortune's Weave rewards those craving both deep interconnected stories and intricate, interlocking RPG systems in equal measure, creating a new high-water mark for the series.

The structure of Fortune's Weave often feels like a series of concentric circles, constantly broadening and deepening your understanding of its systems and its characters. It's so massive it's hard to even know where to start, so I'll begin where the game does: in the future.

Or at least, in a futuristic, science-fiction setting that is strikingly different from the series' norm. Right from the beginning
title: Fire Emblem: Fortune’s Weave Is The Series’ New Peak

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
For years, Overwatch had an infamous player toxicity problem. A few years after its successful 2016 debut, the problem became especially bad whenever a new hero was added to the game, and that was an issue Blizzard wanted to solve. How did it do that? By simultaneously dropping five heroes into the game earlier this year, as part of Overwatch 2's rebuild.

Alongside the game's first year-long story arc, The Reign of Talon, this gamble paid off when Blizzard discovered that toxicity within the player community dropped significantly as users focused more on curiosity and experimentation.

"[At the] start of 2026, we announced 10 heroes, and five of them launched in Season 1," game director Aaron Keller said to GameSpot at
title: This Is How Blizzard Is Reducing Toxicity In Overwatch

author: Darryn Bonthuys
description:
A new PS5 firmware update has arrived, and it's upgrading the console with more than just extra stability. Firmware update version 26.06-14.00.00 offers a new tweak for the PS5 Pro console, voice chat improvements, and tweaks to longstanding features. Here's a breakdown of everything.

For PS5 Pro owners, the update will now see the option for enhanced PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) turned on by default. When this is active, it will allow games to run with sharper, smoother visuals, and it also works with games that support the previous version of PSSR.

If you're feeling social, you can also see who's talking when a voice chat group is active--which should come in very handy for games like Big Walk. You'll need to turn this option on
title: New PS5 Update Is Out Now, And Sony Actually Added Some New Features

description: Wo Long 2 initially looked like it was going to be another game determined to make me suffer. Instead, I had a surprisingly great time and walked away from my Gamescom preview eager to play more.
title: Wo Long 2 Made Me Rethink My Relationship With Souls-Likes – Preview

author: Cheri Faulkner
description:
I went into my hands-on session with Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember expecting to hate it. That probably isn't the sort of sentence Team Ninja wants associated with its upcoming action-RPG, but it's an important one. I've never been great at souls-likes. The combination of punishing enemies, precise timing, complicated combat systems, and the possibility that something resembling an eldritch horror might annihilate me in three hits is not my idea of a fun time. Wo Long 2 initially looked like it was going to be another game determined to make me suffer. Instead, I had a surprisingly great time and walked away from my Gamescom preview eager to play more.

title: Wo Long 2: Wings Of Ember Made Me Rethink My Relationship With Soulslikes
